text: MoE4All 本地推理插件（DSH Web）：连接本地 MoE4All Engine 或兼容 OpenAI 的推理服务，并在 DSH 设置页管理引擎和模型。它通过模型提供方同步发现的模型，支持模型下载、引擎状态与启停、上下文及视觉配置，也为识别的 Qwen 模型提供推理强度选项。适合希望在 DSH 中使用本地或自托管模型的用户；可选配置 MOE4ALL_API_KEY 用于受密钥保护的服务。

MoE4All connects DSH Web to a local Engine or OpenAI-compatible model service. Its settings page manages the engine, discovers models, and supports model downloads, vision, context limits, and Qwen reasoning controls. Use it to run local or self-hosted inference in DSH.

MoE4All 的功能「引擎设置与状态」：在 DSH 设置区查看和调整引擎配置，并通过状态面板查看运行情况；可启动或停止插件管理的引擎。设置保存在 DSH 设置服务中。
MoE4All 的功能「发现并接入模型」：插件按配置访问 OpenAI 兼容端点的 models 接口，筛除重复项和 embedding 名称，再把模型列表同步为 DSH 的 MoE4All 提供方配置。
MoE4All feature “Download recommended models”: choose a model in settings to download its files from Hugging Face.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · dsh-llm-moe4all：`dsh-llm-moe4all` connects DeepSeek Harness (DSH) to a MoE4All OpenAI-compatible server. It can discover models, configure DSH automatically, download and manage local MoE4All Engine releases, and start or stop a guarded local Engine process.

Chat, tools, images, reasoning blocks, retries, and replay stay on DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` adapter. Plugin updates and Engine updates are separate: updating this plugin never replaces the Engine, models, KV cache, or conversations.
dsh-llm-moe4all README · dsh-llm-moe4all：Chinese documentation: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)
dsh-llm-moe4all README · Interface：The same MoE4All page covers Engine status, live slot speed, model selection, automatic profiles, optional capabilities, and advanced settings.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Interface：The chat model selector also offers reasoning controls for discovered Qwen3.5/3.6 models (including 35B) and Qwen3.8 FlashNext. Qwen3.5/3.6 exposes Off, Low, Medium, High, Xhigh, and Max; strength uses the Engine's Qwen35 prompt-instruction mapping, so the Engine must include that support. FlashNext exposes Off, Low, Medium, and Xhigh, matching its native template. Off sends `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false`, not an empty effort. A route containing only these recognized models defaults to Medium unless a provider default was customized. Rediscovery adds missing choices while retaining custom effort mappings and unrelated compatibility settings; other models are not assigned these capabilities by guesswork.

Download the [0.2.4 Windows installer ZIP](https://github.com/Headmaster218/dsh-llm-moe4all/releases/download/release-0.2.4/dsh-llm-moe4all-windows.zip), or check [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/Headmaster218/dsh-llm-moe4all/releases) for newer versions.
2. Extract the ZIP and double-click `Install-MoE4All-Plugin.cmd`.
3. Select the target DSH. When prompted, finish active work, fully exit that DSH instance, and press Enter.
4. Restart the selected DSH. On its first unconfigured start, the plugin opens the MoE4All setup automatically. If it was dismissed, open **Settings > MoE4All**.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · After the catalog listing：Open **Plugin Market**, search for `MoE4All`, choose `dsh-llm-moe4all`, and click **Install**. Restart DSH when prompted. The npm command will become the preferred terminal path after the package is published:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-moe4all
```

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Release bundle details：The Release ZIP contains a prebuilt `dsh-llm-moe4all.tgz`. The one-click installer uses it by default, avoiding Git source resolution and install-time compilation:

```powershell
powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -File .\install-plugin.ps1
```

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Release bundle details：Starting with 0.2.1, ZIP-installed copies can check GitHub Releases and update from inside the plugin. Existing 0.2.0 copies need the newer Windows installer once to gain this capability. Market-managed installations keep the Market update flow when its public API is available.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Quick Start：1. After the required DSH restart, the MoE4All setup opens automatically. On first use the plugin downloads the latest compatible Engine with visible progress and retry controls. If the setup was dismissed, open **Settings > MoE4All**.
2. Select an existing GGUF model or download one of the recommended model families.
3. Keep the conservative automatic profile unless you want to tune memory and paging manually.
4. Click **Run**. The plugin writes the provider configuration, starts the Engine when allowed, and makes discovered models available to DSH.
dsh-llm-moe4all README · Quick Start：The default endpoint is `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`. Existing servers can be used in connection-only mode, including a custom IP, port, and API key.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Quick Start：Automatic Engine installation and the Windows installer support **Windows x86_64**. Other hosts can connect to an existing OpenAI-compatible service; automatic Engine installation there is not supported. Open DSH through its local loopback address to use Engine controls. Real-time throughput is collected from a plugin-managed Engine's output; an external server does not provide those logs.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Quick Start：Inside the integrated MoE4All Agent, model downloads default to the product's stable `models` directory and the native file chooser is owned by the Agent window. The setup defaults to two concurrent slots. Startup failures preserve the original error and logs, with general suggestions to reduce concurrency, reduce context, switch automatic profiles, or choose a smaller model. Built-in plugin updates belong to the Agent bundle; standalone plugin self-updates remain available outside the bundle.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Plugin Updates：The plugin checks shortly after DSH opens and every six hours while its page remains open. Use **Settings > MoE4All > Diagnostics > Check plugin updates** for a manual check. Downloading/installing a plugin update always requires confirmation.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Plugin Updates：- **ZIP/local `.tgz` installs:** check this repository's latest stable GitHub Release, not `main` or prerelease tags. The prompt shows download progress, stop/retry controls, and a release-page link. SHA256 and the prebuilt package are verified before the current DSH profile's installer runs with dependency build scripts disabled. Only this plugin's dependency is retargeted; an installation failure attempts to restore the previous manifest, lockfile, and package. Backups remain in `profiles/<profile>/.moe4all-plugin-updates`.
- **Market/npm/Git installs:** continue through the public `/dsh-market/api/v1/*` API when available. Development links/checkouts are not silently replaced by release archives. Unsupported hosts can use the Windows installer or their original installation method.
- Update from the local loopback UI after stopping the plugin-managed Engine and finishing active agent runs. An external Engine is never stopped by the updater.
- After a standalone update, **restart DSH manually** to load the new code. The updater does not terminate DSH, restart Desktop, or stop the Engine itself.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Plugin Updates：For an npm-installed copy (after npm publication), update with:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-llm-moe4all
```

Restart the DSH profile after a Bundle update.

The ZIP installer pins a versioned local `.tgz`; the command above cannot fetch a newer local archive. Use the built-in Release updater (0.2.1+) or rerun the newer ZIP installer for the same DSH home. Catalog listing does not convert a local-file dependency into a market-managed one.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Disable or Uninstall：Use DSH's **Plugins** page to disable the Bundle without removing it. To uninstall it completely from the `web` profile:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-llm-moe4all
```

Restart DSH afterward. Removal preserves MoE4All Engine files, downloaded models, KV cache, and saved plugin settings so an accidental uninstall does not delete large local data.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Compatibility：- Verified with DSH `0.1.1-rc.2` (DSH Desktop `0.6.3`), DSH `0.1.5-rc.3`, and the official DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` line.
- The manifest explicitly admits the known DSH `0.1.1` through `0.1.7` prerelease lines and the `0.2.0` prerelease/stable line.
- Node.js **20.3.0 or newer** is required by this plugin; DSH may require a newer version. Builds use the pinned Node/npm versions in `.node-version` and `package.json`.
- CI checks all three verified DSH lines with frozen dependency lockfiles. The `0.1.1-rc.2` and `0.2.0-rc.2` runtime tests install the packaged plugin, verify host access and native-provider model discovery, and exercise plugin self-update, failure rollback, and restart activation without loading GPU models. Node, npm, pnpm, and Actions are pinned; the Windows runner uses the `windows-2025` family.
- Declared intermediate DSH lines and non-Windows hosts are not additional end-to-end test results.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Configuration：Most users should configure the plugin in **Settings > MoE4All**. The page covers local or remote connection, model library, conservative/aggressive automatic profiles, context and output limits, MTP, vision, embeddings, KV session cache, Engine versions, startup behavior, and advanced launch arguments.

For deployment automation, the Bundle row remains configurable in YAML:

```yaml
- id: moe4all-engine
  config:
    mode: auto
    host: 127.0.0.1

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Configuration：`MOE4ALL_ENGINE` may provide the executable path. Remote endpoints require `allowRemoteEndpoint: true`; the plugin never launches an Engine on another machine. A managed local Engine can explicitly listen on a local LAN address or `0.0.0.0`, with a persistent API key for non-loopback serving. API key values are stored through DSH credentials, not in the plugin's ordinary configuration.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Configuration：Startup choices are **manual**, **ask on DSH startup**, or **automatic**. Low resources or an unavailable resource measurement require confirmation; a busy port offers a free alternative rather than stopping another process. By default, unloading/disabling the plugin or exiting DSH stops only its own Engine (`stopOnUnload: true`). An externally started server is never stopped.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Permissions and Data：It does not upload model files, conversation content, or API keys to the plugin repository. Remote endpoint access and non-loopback Engine serving require explicit configuration.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Troubleshooting：- **Plugin does not appear:** fully restart the DSH profile after install and confirm `dsh-llm-moe4all` is enabled under **Plugins**.
- **Installer cannot find DSH:** install DSH Desktop, or put `dsh` on `PATH`, then rerun the script. The manual command is printed on failure.
- **Update prompt never appears:** check manually under **Diagnostics**. ZIP self-updates require 0.2.1+; 0.2.0 needs one installer upgrade. Market-managed copies require the public DSH Market update API. Network failures offer retry and the release-page link.
- **Engine does not start:** open **Settings > MoE4All > Diagnostics** and inspect startup output. A busy configured port or low free RAM/VRAM requires confirmation or a different port; unrelated local inference processes are not blocked.
- **Need to roll back:** use DSH Market's rollback action when offered, or install a known package/tag and restart the profile.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Troubleshooting：When reporting a bug, include the plugin version, DSH version, operating system, and the relevant diagnostic lines. Remove API keys, private paths, prompts, and other personal data first.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Development：The repository includes compiled `lib/` output so GitHub installs do not need install-time build approval. Both `v<package-version>` and `release-<package-version>` tags trigger publication. The tag must exactly match `package.json`. Release publication waits for the compatibility matrix and official installation smoke test, then creates a prebuilt `.tgz`, a one-click Windows ZIP, and SHA-256 hashes. Prerelease versions are marked as prereleases; this workflow does **not** publish to npm.

dsh-llm-moe4all README · Development：See [Maintaining and Releasing](docs/maintaining.md) for module boundaries, validation, and the ready-to-copy catalog submission entry. Screenshots are declared in [screenshots.json](screenshots.json); catalog listing is separate from releasing the plugin.
